cohort: 304 multiparous women with pregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM) who delivered at ≥34 weeks gestational age
finding: Prior breastfeeding experience leads to better breastfeeding initiation rates while the absence of breastfeeding experience adds a risk for breastfeeding initiation failure.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was similar between groups with and without prior breastfeeding experience (vaginal: 36% & 37%, cesarean: 64% & 63%).
birth_weight: Similar between groups; overall mean birth weight was 3553g
